_comment: Run configuration for result files written before evaluate_vlm.py stamped a
run_config block into its own output. Each entry names where the value came
from. Nothing here is a guess: a value is recorded only when a launch script
in this repository fixes it, and collate.py marks every run that leans on
this file so no number silently claims provenance it does not have.
Delete an entry once that observer has been re-run under the current code,

_source.local_models: bench/launch_hard_queue.sh sets MAX_TOKENS=8000 and PROMPT=cot_anyview for every model in the queue
_source.api_models: bench/run_openrouter.sh invoked with MAX_TOKENS=8000 WORKERS=16; the value is not otherwise attested in the result file
